title: Kite

<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <line x1='22' y1='42' x2='78' y2='42' stroke='#fff3b0' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- bow tail -->
  <path d='M50,80 Q58,86 50,92 Q42,96 50,99' fill='none' stroke='#9b5de5' stroke-width='2'/>
  <polygon points='44,84 56,82 52,89 44,88' fill='#f15bb5'/>
